text: Eating a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains gives your body the energy it needs. Regular exercise, like walking or cycling for at least thirty minutes a day, helps keep your heart healthy and your muscles strong. But don’t forget sleep and rest – most adults need seven to nine hours each night to repair and recharge. Equally important is mental health: managing stress through hobbies, spending time with loved ones, or practising mindfulness. Finally, work-life balance means setting boundaries so you have time for both responsibilities and relaxation. By paying attention to these areas, you can enjoy a healthier, happier life.
